raul_ops: @here quick heads-up — we're opening a small dedicated L100 pool in Mexico City (mex1) today for preview customers. :rocket:

raul_ops: Pool name: `dedicated-L100-mex1-preview` — initial capacity = 12 cards. Targeting low-latency inference for regionally routed workloads.

anya_pm: Nice. Any changes to reservation semantics or burst policy we should flag to customers?

raul_ops: Yes — two important notes: 1) Reservations are supported but billed at preview rates (see internal pricing). 2) Burst policy will prefer local L100 capacity first, then fall back to nearby AMS2 then to shared-hosted if needed. We'll log fallbacks in the console. :information_source:

kim_sre: Rollout window? Ops runbook? I want to add probes to SRE dashboards.

raul_ops: Rollout starts 2026-03-25 18:00 UTC — 2h canary, then scale to full preview. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/l100-mex1-preview (internal). Probe names: `mex1-l100-health` and `mex1-l100-latency`.

maria_sales: Heads-up: Sales pilot customers in LATAM — I'll email the list and include migration steps. Is there a recommended migration flag for current Dedicated customers?

raul_ops: Yes, use `rb-reserve --pool dedicated-L100-mex1-preview --size <n>` or console -> Dedicated -> Pools -> select L100-mex1 -> Migrate workloads. For CLI quick example:

```
# reserve 4 cards in mex1
rb-reserve --pool dedicated-L100-mex1-preview --size 4 --duration 30d
```

zack_ce: Will quantization profiles be pre-baked on the L100 images or will customers need to re-run compile?

kim_sre: We're shipping a default quant profile tuned for common transformer families. Nonstandard models will need a one-time compile; we added a warning in the reservation UI.

anya_pm: Can we add a short note in the Console announcement banner about possible short fallbacks during canary hours? Want to set expectations.

raul_ops: Good call — will add banner: "mex1 L100 preview may fallback to AMS2 for the first 2 hours of canary".

deploy-bot: Deployment started for pool `dedicated-L100-mex1-preview` at 2026-03-25T18:00:05Z (canary stage).

raul_ops: Postmortem/monitoring anchors: please watch token p95 latency, error-rate, and KV cache hit-rate. If fallback > 5% in first 30m, we pause scale up.

maria_sales: Thanks — I'll pass the migration CLI snippet to pilot customers and include billing caveat.

zack_ce: Can we schedule a short tech brief for CE tomorrow 10:00am PT? Need to prep demo prompts and latency expectations.

raul_ops: Scheduled. Calendar invite sent. :white_check_mark:
